geometry_intent.cavity_profile: west wall bows left across its full height, ceiling undulates128–176wu, east heel bows outward before curling into the cache, western floor swells into a thick asymmetric root
geometry_intent.continuity: crown fragments meet one undulating heartwood ceiling; the outward-bowed heel joins crown and cache floor; the bowed western butt and swollen western floor meet the low root
geometry_intent.exterior: exposed crown jumps have a real shallow fracture floor, not more floating short platforms
geometry_intent.inside: one broad inner chamber; two broken floor sections reveal the recoverable low root
geometry_intent.source: a fallen hollow trunk with a split butt, two crown fractures and an intact heel
geometry_intent.visual_acceptance: unverified; same shared terrain consumer does not sign material or composition

original.identity: fallen trunk: broken crown or sheltered heartwood

play_contract.alternative: A skilled reverse entry through the intact heel is legitimate if the real body's route permits it; no visited-crown or prescribed-input lock.
play_contract.counterexample: Immediate butt drop, missed each exterior jump, missed each inner fracture, direct crown-to-cache fall, zero-H jumping, and heel back-entry.
play_contract.decision: Stay above the fallen tree for the easier exposed route, or commit to the interior fractures and guarded heartwood cache.
play_contract.new_information: The inner floor breaks show the same low root that later passes beneath the intact heel and rejoins the outside route.
play_contract.observe: The split butt shows the sheltered passage below before the first outer jump.
play_contract.reward: A closed-end cache needs a full inside journey and a return over its thorn patch; the region must own an actual OR reward transaction.
play_contract.world_requirement: Connect exit/onward to an actual next destination. failure is already on the same low root. Returning to the high entry is not claimed.

variant_contract.change: outer fractures widen from96 to112wu; crown and heel move while inner floor breaks retain their placement
